Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 도끼의 느낌이 애매하다고 말한다. 어떻게 할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> says something feels off with her axe. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が斧の感触が曖昧だと言う。どうする？

Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說斧頭的感覺不對勁。該怎麼辦呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dit que sa hache lui semble étrange. Que faire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sagt, dass sich die Axt seltsam anfühlt. Was sollte ich sagen?

Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengatakan perasaan kapak itu tidak jelas. Bagaimana kita bisa mengatasinya?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói rằng chiếc rìu của cô ấy có gì đó không ổn. Tôi nên nói gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> कहती है कि उसकी कुल्हाड़ी में कुछ गड़बड़ है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Denk mal über den Grund nach?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Pensou em um motivo para parar?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Thử nghĩ xem lý do là gì?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: क्या हम थोड़ी देर रुककर पता लगाएँ कि क्या गड़बड़ है?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Lass uns einen anderen Akt versuchen.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Hãy thử một bài tập khác xem sao.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: चलो, कोई और अभ्यास करके देखते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió dejar de entrenar y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treino e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk menghentikan latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết định ngừng tập luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण रोककर आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'elle ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait encore insatisfaite.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschlossen hatte, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ก็ดูเหมือนจะยังรู้สึกไม่เต็มที่
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Mặc dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, nhưng <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a relevé le défi de l'entraînement et a obtenu de bons résultats.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo buenos resultados.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente e obteve bons resultados.

Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम हासिल किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.

Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber wieder.

Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente, mas falhou mais uma vez.

Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> thử lại nhưng lại thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रही।

Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
